text:
I got my EVGA 3070 XC3 Ultra thru the que also on the 20th. Did some benchmarks on it over 2 days, stayed cool as can be!
Left it on when I went shopping for an hour and a half, 2 at max. Sat down at my computer when I got home and smelled electrical smoke and noticed my PC was off. Turned it on and instantly saw smoke coming out, turned it off instantly. 
Took the video card out and found there was burn marks and some slight melting or something that looked strange on the pcb near the end of the card closest to where it's connected to my case and some browning/over heat indications along the same area where it connects to the PCIe slot.  Man it freaked me out!
I thought damn I bet it fried my mobo too! So, I put my old video card back in and it ran fine, to my huge relief! But because after looking closely at the card I realized I'd missed removing the protective film on the back plate, I thought I was screwed, felt sick about it, but called EVGA explained exactly what happened including that somehow I missed seeing the protective film on the back plate, the one with red letters reminding dummies like me to take it off.
But was told that never should of happened even with the film on. And I had monitored the GOU tems over the previous 2 days that I spent benchmarking the card and never saw a temp go higher than 70 C!
The man that helped me was awesome! I had an RMA within an hour of emailing photos and a new card was shipped and will be here tomorrow! Can't yell you how relieved I was!!!! EVGA has the best CS I've ever worked with! I was afraid I was SOL!!! I'll stick with EVGA every time!!  I got $70 discounted off my card as well so I paid under the amount they were charging after they upped the price, which is good until this April!
